name: @jx0/jmux

scripts.docker: docker build -f Dockerfile.test -t jmux-test . && docker run --rm -it jmux-test
scripts.test:snapshot-orphan: docker build -f Dockerfile.snapshot-test -t jmux-snapshot-test . && docker run --rm jmux-snapshot-test

scripts.test:installer: docker build -f Dockerfile.installer -t jmux-installer-test . && docker run --rm jmux-installer-test
scripts.test:installer-musl: docker build -f Dockerfile.installer-musl -t jmux-installer-musl . && docker run --rm jmux-installer-musl
